grounded_facts: One of the Jamie Delaney snatches the the small photograph from Drew Vaughn as he tries to set the timer, leaving him injured and defenseless.
memories.memory_text: I saw one of the Jamie Delaney snatch the the small photograph from Drew Vaughn just as he was trying to set the timer, and he went down hard, injured and defenseless.

grounded_facts: A high-tension encounter between Lane Sterling, Drew Vaughn, and multiple Jamie Delaney in an underground cavern, resulting in entrapment and loss of resources.
memories.memory_text: I was there when the Jamie Delaney appeared, snarling as the light hit his face, and I felt the shock when the metal wall rose behind us—trapped—and saw Drew Vaughn get injured trying to set the explosives before one of them snatched the belts away.

grounded_facts: Three Jamie Delaney appear in the cavern, one already present and two emerging from the water, threatening Lane Sterling and Drew Vaughn.
memories.memory_text: I saw a Jamie Delaney emerge from the water and shake itself off, then a third one raised its head—I realized we were completely surrounded and in immediate danger when one of them attacked Drew Vaughn and snatched the explosives.

grounded_facts: Lane Sterling uses the radio to call Marco for urgent help, signaling desperation and the need for external intervention.
Lane Sterling uses the radio to urgently call Marco for help.
memories.memory_text: I used the radio to call Marco urgently for help, shouting into it because I was desperate and knew I needed immediate assistance.

grounded_facts: Jamie Brooks crashes through the ceiling and lands on one of the Jamie Delaney, crushing it and interrupting the attack on Lane Sterling and Drew Vaughn.
memories.memory_text: I saw Jamie Brooks crash through the ceiling and land on one of the Jamie Delaney, crushing it under the Sidney Nolan, which stopped the attack for a moment.

grounded_facts: Jamie Brooks scoops up Drew Vaughn and moves him to safety beside Lane Sterling.
memories.memory_text: I saw Jamie Brooks scoop up Drew Vaughn and move him to safety right beside me, putting us together where we could both stay protected.

grounded_facts: Two new Jamie Delaney are born from glowing eggs, increasing their number to five.
memories.memory_text: I saw two glowing eggs transform right before my eyes, and suddenly there were two more Jamie Delaney—five in total now.

grounded_facts: Multiple Jamie Delaney overwhelm Jamie Brooks, biting and knocking him to the ground, leaving him in critical condition.
memories.memory_text: I watched the Jamie Delaney swarm Jamie Brooks, biting and knocking him down until he was covered in blood and couldn't get up.

grounded_facts: Lane Sterling begs Drew Vaughn to hit her, seeking to trigger her power through trauma.
memories.memory_text: I begged Drew Vaughn to hit me because I knew I had to stop running from my power and finally face it.

grounded_facts: Frustrated by Drew Vaughn' hesitation, Lane Sterling slaps him to force action.
memories.memory_text: I slapped Drew Vaughn when he hesitated, needing him to act so I could trigger what had to come.

grounded_facts: Lane Sterling declares her love for Jamie Brooks, marking an emotional turning point that precedes her power activation.
memories.memory_text: I realized and declared that I love Jamie Brooks—I've always loved him—and in that moment, something inside me shifted.

grounded_facts: Drew Vaughn finally hits Lane Sterling as she requested, triggering her power surge.
memories.memory_text: I felt the sting of Drew Vaughn' slap across my face, the sharp pain I asked for, and I knew it was the trigger I needed.

grounded_facts: After being slapped by Drew Vaughn, Lane Sterling unleashes a massive surge of fire that engulfs and destroys all the Jamie Delaney.
memories.memory_text: After the slap, I unleashed a massive surge of fire from my arms that engulfed and destroyed all the Jamie Delaney around me.

grounded_facts: A battle between Jamie Brooks, Lane Sterling, Drew Vaughn, and multiple Jamie Delaney in an underground tunnel.
memories.memory_text: I was fighting alongside Jamie Brooks and Drew Vaughn against multiple Jamie Delaney in an underground tunnel, trying to defend ourselves as they kept coming at us.

grounded_facts: Jamie Brooks regains consciousness bound to a wooden yoke in a ceremonial chamber beneath a church, surrounded by occult machinery and figures.
memories.memory_text: I remember waking up chained to a wooden yoke in a vast chamber beneath a church, surrounded by statues, gears, and an eerie solar system model where an altar should be, with Jesse Nolan standing over me in ceremonial robes.

grounded_facts: Micah Sterling declares Jamie Brooks to be the key and commands him to open the locks.
memories.memory_text: I saw Micah Sterling face Jamie Brooks and declare that he was the key, the right hand of doom, and then command him to open the locks.

grounded_facts: Drew Vaughn desperately warns Jamie Brooks not to activate the portal.
memories.memory_text: I heard Drew Vaughn shout desperately at Jamie Brooks, begging him not to activate the portal.

grounded_facts: Jesse Nolan whispers to Lane Sterling, causing her to emit a plume of energy which he inhales; she then dies.
memories.memory_text: I felt Jesse Nolan lean over me and whisper something, and then I emitted a plume of energy that he inhaled before I died.

grounded_facts: Overcome with rage after Lane Sterling's death, Jamie Brooks breaks one of his restraints and attacks Micah Sterling.
memories.memory_text: I remember seeing Jamie Brooks struggle in rage after I died — he broke one of his cuffs and swatted Micah Sterling away, fighting to get free.

grounded_facts: A ceremonial event led by Jesse Nolan (Jesse Nolan) to open the bottomless pit using Jamie Brooks as the key during a lunar eclipse.
memories.memory_text: I recall Jesse Nolan leading a ritual during a lunar eclipse, invoking an angel with the key to the bottomless pit and demanding Jamie Brooks open the door, offering my life and soul in exchange.

grounded_facts: Jesse Nolan proposes that Jamie Brooks open the door in exchange for Lane Sterling's life, then her soul.
memories.memory_text: I remember Jesse Nolan standing over me, telling Jamie Brooks to open the door in exchange for my life, then saying my soul was waiting on the other side if he wanted me back.

grounded_facts: After being told Lane Sterling's soul awaits on the other side, Jamie Brooks consents to become the key and open the door.
memories.memory_text: I was told my soul was on the other side, and Jamie Brooks heard the same—he must have known I was gone, but still chose to open the door for me.

grounded_facts: Jesse Nolan explains the power of names and reveals Jamie Brooks's true name.
memories.memory_text: I remember lying at Jesse Nolan's feet as he spoke about the power of names, turning his back to Jamie Brooks while facing the mural. I heard him say that names hold the power and nature of things, and he gave his own as an example—Jesse Nolan, meaning 'The crossroads,' and how he had become that.

grounded_facts: Jamie Brooks speaks his true name, Anung-un-Rama, initiating transformation into the key.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed Jamie Brooks speak his true name, Anung-un-Rama, and in that moment, I saw the transformation begin, as if he were becoming the key.

grounded_facts: Jamie Brooks takes Lane Sterling's limp body in his arms and begins to move with her.
memories.memory_text: I felt Jamie Brooks take my limp body in his arms and carry me away, his movements heavy with grief.

grounded_facts: Jamie Brooks hands over Lane Sterling's body to Drew Vaughn, instructing him to keep her safe while he confronts the unknown threat.
memories.memory_text: I remember Jamie Brooks carefully handing my body over to Drew Vaughn, though I couldn't move or speak.

grounded_facts: Jamie Brooks gives a direct order to Drew Vaughn to keep Lane Sterling safe no matter what.
memories.memory_text: I heard Jamie Brooks tell Drew Vaughn to keep me safe no matter what before he went ahead.

grounded_facts: Drew Vaughn expresses concern by asking if Jamie Brooks intends to face the threat alone.
memories.memory_text: I heard Drew Vaughn ask Jamie Brooks if he was going alone, his voice filled with concern.

grounded_facts: A large tentacle suddenly appears in the tunnel, smashes oil lamps onto Jamie Brooks's head, and pulls him backward at high speed.
memories.memory_text: I felt the sudden rush and impact as a massive tentacle smashed through the tunnel, yanking Jamie Brooks away.

grounded_facts: Jamie Brooks cradles Lane Sterling's head and whispers lovingly to her, helping her return from death.
memories.memory_text: I felt Jamie Brooks cradling my head against his chest, his hand gently holding me, and I sensed him looking at me with love as he caressed my hair.

grounded_facts: Jamie Brooks whispers a powerful declaration of sacrifice to bring Lane Sterling back, stating he would die and cross over for her.
memories.memory_text: I heard Jamie Brooks whisper that he would die and cross over for me, and that the other side would be sorry if they didn’t let me go — I learned then that he was offering his life for mine.

grounded_facts: Lane Sterling looks at Jamie Brooks and sees him not just as a monster, but as the man she loves.
memories.memory_text: I looked at Jamie Brooks and saw him not as a monster, but as the man I love.

grounded_facts: Lane Sterling regains consciousness after Jamie Brooks's declaration, responding to his voice and beginning to perceive him as the man she loves.
memories.memory_text: I heard your voice in the dark — I'm not sure what you said, but it pulled me back.

grounded_facts: Drew Vaughn smiles sadly and Blair Hayes watches as Jamie Brooks and Lane Sterling reunite, both observing the emotional climax.
memories.memory_text: I saw Drew Vaughn smiling sadly and Blair Hayes watching as Jamie Brooks and I came together, their quiet presence bearing witness to the moment that brought me back.

grounded_facts: A pivotal moment in the tunnel where Lane Sterling is brought back to life through Jamie Brooks's declaration of love and sacrifice.
memories.memory_text: I opened my eyes and saw Jamie Brooks for who he truly is — the man I love — and as we kissed, I felt my fire warm around us, bringing me fully back to life.

grounded_facts: Jamie Brooks and Lane Sterling share a kiss, symbolizing their love and completing her return to life, accompanied by rising fire and music.
memories.memory_text: I felt the warmth of Jamie Brooks's lips on mine, our kiss sealing everything—our love, my return—as fire rose around us and music swelled in the air.

grounded_facts: Jonah Brooks smiles and calls the infant Jamie Brooks by name, marking a moment of affectionate recognition.
memories.memory_text: I remember Jonah Brooks smiling at me and calling me Jamie Brooks—it felt like the first time I truly had a name and someone who cared.

grounded_facts: Jamie Brooks becomes the subject of widespread tabloid coverage, including sightings, conspiracy theories, and sensational TV segments, establishing his public mythos.
memories.memory_text: I saw how I started showing up in tabloids and on TV, with people talking about sightings and wild theories—I realized I was becoming a myth out there.

grounded_facts: Blair Hayes voice-over expresses disbelief, calling the footage a costume and mocking public gullibility.
memories.memory_text: I heard Blair Hayes’s voice dismissing the footage, saying it was just a costume and mocking those who believed—so I knew he didn’t see me as real.

grounded_facts: Jonah Brooks sees the image of Jamie Brooks on multiple television screens in an electronics store window, prompting an emotional reaction.
memories.memory_text: I saw my image on all those TV screens in the store window, and Jonah Brooks was looking at me, calling me 'son' with that soft look in his eyes.

grounded_facts: Jesse Mercer introduces Drew Vaughn as Jamie Brooks's new liaison in the den, marking a transition of responsibility.
memories.memory_text: I was told that Drew Vaughn is my new liaison, assigned to me in the den, marking a change I didn't ask for.

grounded_facts: Jamie Brooks explicitly states he does not want Drew Vaughn as his new liaison, showing resistance to change.
memories.memory_text: I told Drew Vaughn I don't want him as my new liaison.

grounded_facts: Following Jesse Mercer's hint, Drew Vaughn gives Jamie Brooks the Baby Ruths, marking the first gesture of goodwill.
memories.memory_text: I saw Drew Vaughn offer me the Baby Ruths after coming into the light, and I remember how he recoiled at first — this was the first gesture of goodwill from him, following Jesse Mercer's hint.

grounded_facts: Drew Vaughn sees Jamie Brooks for the first time in the flesh, realizing the supernatural being is real and physically imposing.
memories.memory_text: I saw Drew Vaughn jump when I dropped the dumbbell, and I noticed him staring at my horn stumps—I realized he was seeing me for the first time and taking in what I really am.

grounded_facts: Jamie Brooks notices Drew Vaughn staring at his horn stumps and directly challenges him.
memories.memory_text: I noticed Drew Vaughn staring at my horn stumps, so I called him out on it right away.

grounded_facts: Jamie Brooks asks Drew Vaughn for his first name, initiating personal engagement.
memories.memory_text: I asked Drew Vaughn for his first name to start talking to him directly.

grounded_facts: An alarm sounds and Jamie Brooks light blinks, indicating an operational shift or mission start.
memories.memory_text: I heard an alarm sound and saw a Jamie Brooks light blink on the wall, so I knew it was time to move out.

grounded_facts: Jamie Brooks comments on the ugliness of the crowd, highlighting the barrier between them and normal society.
memories.memory_text: I told Taylor Sloane, 'Look at them ugly suckers, Blue. One sheet of glass between them and us,' because I could feel how separate we were from normal life.

grounded_facts: Taylor Sloane responds to Jamie Brooks's observation about the crowd with a reflection on his own life, emphasizing emotional and physical separation.
memories.memory_text: I heard Taylor Sloane say 'Story of my life' after I commented on the crowd, and I knew he was feeling that separation too, in his own way.

grounded_facts: Jamie Brooks expresses nostalgia and longing for being outside, hinting at a desire for normalcy and romantic connection.
memories.memory_text: I said, 'Outside. I could be outside --' because I was aching for something more, something normal, something free.

grounded_facts: A nighttime operation where the team is inside a modified garbage truck serving as a mobile crime lab, observing a crowd and preparing for action.
memories.memory_text: I was inside the modified garbage truck with the team during the nighttime operation, watching the crowd through the glass and feeling the distance between us and them.

grounded_facts: Jamie Brooks retrieves a large, custom-built handgun from a steel box labeled 'The Good Samaritan' and prepares to use it.
memories.memory_text: I unlocked the steel box labeled 'The Good Samaritan' and took out my custom-built handgun, feeling its weight as I got ready to use it.

grounded_facts: Taylor Sloane interprets Jamie Brooks's nostalgia as a desire to reconnect with Lane Sterling, pointing out her absence directly.
memories.memory_text: I remember Taylor Sloane telling me that I meant 'outside... with her,' interpreting my words as a desire to reconnect with Lane Sterling, like he could see right through me.

grounded_facts: Taylor Sloane counters Jamie Brooks's deflection by directly referencing Lane Sterling's departure and urging him to accept the reality of his situation.
memories.memory_text: I was told, 'Lane Sterling left us, Jamie Brooks. Take the hint,' and even though it hit hard, I wasn't ready to accept it just then.

grounded_facts: Lakeside Council/Crown Hill Department teams secure the courtyard and seal off the area by closing the gate.
memories.memory_text: I saw the agents closing the gate to seal off the courtyard as we prepared to move in.

grounded_facts: A coordinated operation entry by Jamie Brooks and Blue teams at the Harborview Street loading dock.
memories.memory_text: I inferred that the Jamie Brooks and Blue teams were making a coordinated entry at the Harborview Street loading dock based on Jesse Mercer's order and our deployment from the truck.

grounded_facts: Jesse Mercer instructs Jamie Brooks and Taylor Sloane to synchronize their locators.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Jesse Mercer to synchronize my locator with Taylor Sloane's.

grounded_facts: Jesse Mercer, Taylor Sloane, and Jamie Brooks activate locator beacons on their belts to synchronize.
memories.memory_text: I activated the locator on my belt and saw it blink and beep along with Jesse Mercer's and Taylor Sloane's.

grounded_facts: The dumpster loader lowers, revealing Jamie Brooks and Taylor Sloane inside the garbage truck.
memories.memory_text: I was inside the garbage truck with Taylor Sloane when Jesse Mercer lowered the dumpster loader, and I saw the way out. I activated my belt light and started moving.

grounded_facts: Jesse Mercer, Drew Vaughn, Taylor Sloane, and Jamie Brooks enter the main lobby of Harborview Street following a reported break-in and robbery.
memories.memory_text: I walked into the main lobby of the Harborview Street with Jesse Mercer, Drew Vaughn, and Taylor Sloane after hearing about a break-in.

grounded_facts: A Crown Hill Department team investigates the Harborview Street after a break-in and robbery resulting in six guard deaths.
memories.memory_text: I figured we were investigating the Harborview Street after a break-in and robbery that left six guards dead, based on what I saw and heard.

grounded_facts: Jesse Mercer reports that an alarm was tripped at 1900 hours due to a break-in and robbery, with six guards found dead.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Jesse Mercer that an alarm went off at 1900 hours because of a break-in and robbery, and that six guards were found dead.

grounded_facts: Jonah Brooks reveals that not everything in the library was a fake, contradicting Jamie Brooks's assumption.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Graham Rivers that not everything in the library was a fake, which surprised me because I had assumed it all was.

grounded_facts: Jamie Brooks expresses surprise upon seeing Jonah Brooks, addressing him as 'Graham Rivers'.
memories.memory_text: I was surprised to see Graham Rivers there and called out to him, not expecting him.

grounded_facts: Jamie Brooks sheepishly averts his gaze from Jonah Brooks, indicating discomfort or guilt.
memories.memory_text: I felt uneasy under his gaze and had to look away, feeling sheepish about how I must have appeared to him.

grounded_facts: Jonah Brooks explains the origin and true nature of the 16th-century statue, revealing it was a prison for a dangerous entity listed by the Vatican.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Jonah Brooks that the 16th-century statue was more than just a relic—it was a prison for something dangerous, smuggled into the country and hollowed out to contain an entity the Vatican considered so threatening it ended up on the List of Avignon.

grounded_facts: Jamie Brooks selects a clip and speed loader filled with specially crafted bullets containing holy water, silver shavings, and white oak.
memories.memory_text: I picked out a clip and speed loader with bullets I made myself—loaded with holy water, silver shavings, and white oak—because I knew I’d need something special to take down whatever was lurking out there.

grounded_facts: Taylor Sloane uses his abilities to sense a malevolent presence behind the brass doors, identifying it as ancient, evil, and hungry.
memories.memory_text: I heard Taylor Sloane say there was a dark entity behind the door — evil, ancient, and hungry — and I knew we were walking into serious trouble.

grounded_facts: Jamie Brooks opens the brass doors and steps into the illuminated room, initiating direct engagement with the unknown entity.
memories.memory_text: I opened the brass doors and stepped into the glowing room, ready to face whatever was in there.

grounded_facts: A nighttime disturbance at the Harborview Street involving destruction, death, and the presence of a hostile creature.
memories.memory_text: I pieced it together from the remains on the floor—half-chewed boots, torn uniforms, and belts—along with the destruction all around and that awful sound above me; something had attacked the hall, killed people, and was still here feeding.

grounded_facts: Jamie Brooks notices a large creature hanging from the ceiling, chewing on remains, and identifies the scene of destruction.
memories.memory_text: I moved through the wreckage under the blue emergency lights, startled by falling debris, and then I heard the sickening sound of bones snapping and chewing—my eyes followed the noise upward and I saw a huge pale creature hanging from the ceiling, feeding on something below.

grounded_facts: Jamie Brooks mocks the creature Jamie Delaney for eating guards, belts, and boots, using dark humor to confront it.
memories.memory_text: I mocked that stinking creature Jamie Delaney, telling him the kitchen was closed and taunting him about eating six guards raw, belts and boots included, because he'd need heavy fiber to move that out.

grounded_facts: Taylor Sloane communicates via earphone that he has discovered something significant.
memories.memory_text: I was told over the earpiece that Taylor Sloane found something significant while I was confronting Jamie Delaney.

grounded_facts: Jamie Delaney's monstrous form is partially exposed, showing cracked, slimy white skin with blue veins, indicating his non-human nature.
memories.memory_text: I saw Jamie Delaney's neck split open, revealing pale, slimy skin cracked like old marble with blue veins pulsing underneath — he wasn't human at all.

grounded_facts: Jamie Brooks tries to de-escalate the situation by proposing a peaceful resolution before resorting to violence.
Jamie Brooks verbally attempts to negotiate a peaceful resolution with Jamie Delaney.
memories.memory_text: I tried to talk Jamie Delaney down, telling him we could work things out peacefully, even though I had 'The Samaritan' ready with big bullets just in case.

grounded_facts: Jamie Delaney violently twists his body 360 degrees and leaps away, rejecting any possibility of negotiation.
memories.memory_text: I saw Jamie Delaney twist his body violently and leap away, making it clear he wasn't going to talk.

grounded_facts: Jamie Brooks shoots Jamie Delaney with high-caliber ammunition, causing significant damage and ultimately bringing him down.
memories.memory_text: I opened fire on Jamie Delaney with my high-caliber weapon and brought him down after the shots hit him.

grounded_facts: Taylor Sloane attempts to relay important information to Jamie Brooks via earpiece, but is cut off.
memories.memory_text: I heard Taylor Sloane trying to tell me something urgent over the earpiece, but I cut him off before he could finish.

grounded_facts: Jamie Brooks decides to ignore Taylor Sloane's urgent message, indicating he considers the situation resolved.
memories.memory_text: I told Sammy it was over, turned away, and holstered my the glass box because I knew the threat was neutralized.

grounded_facts: The corpse that Jamie Brooks was observing suddenly vanishes without explanation.
memories.memory_text: I was looking at the corpse, and then it was suddenly gone—I didn't see how it disappeared.

grounded_facts: Taylor Sloane's voice recites ominous descriptions of the 'Hound of resurrection' from an unseen source, providing cryptic information to Jamie Brooks.
memories.memory_text: I heard Taylor Sloane's voice telling me about the 'Hound of resurrection'—something about it being a harbinger of pestilence and a seed of destruction.

grounded_facts: Jamie Brooks interrupts Taylor Sloane's recitation, urgently asking how to kill the creature.
memories.memory_text: I interrupted Taylor Sloane, urgently asking him how to kill the creature.

grounded_facts: Jamie Delaney suddenly appears and violently strikes Jamie Brooks, sending him crashing into the brass doors.
memories.memory_text: I didn't see Jamie Delaney coming—he just appeared and slammed me hard into the brass doors.

grounded_facts: Jamie Brooks repeatedly impacts the library doors, causing them to bulge and crack under the force.
memories.memory_text: I kept slamming into the library doors, feeling them give way as they bulged and cracked under my force.

grounded_facts: Jamie Delaney launches a powerful physical attack on Jamie Brooks, causing him to crash through multiple glass cabinets and fall through a window.
memories.memory_text: I was hit by a massive punch from Jamie Delaney, and I went crashing through six glass cabinets before falling through a window.

grounded_facts: Jamie Brooks lands sideways in an industrial garbage bin after falling two stories, injured and struggling to stay conscious.
memories.memory_text: I landed hard in a garbage bin after falling two stories, and I could feel blood in my mouth while I fought to stay conscious.

grounded_facts: Jesse Nolan appears and claims to have brought Jamie Brooks into the world, asserting exclusive knowledge of his true name and calling.
Jesse Nolan speaks to Jamie Brooks with a tone of condescending familiarity, claiming a Graham Rivers-like role in his origin.
memories.memory_text: I heard Jesse Nolan speak to me with a condescending tone, calling me 'child' and claiming he brought me into the world, sang my first lullaby, and that only he knows my true name and calling.

grounded_facts: Jesse Nolan orders Jamie Delaney to discipline Jamie Brooks for his lack of understanding of his place.
memories.memory_text: I heard Jesse Nolan tell me that he alone knows my true calling and true name, and then I heard him say I don't know my place before ordering Jamie Delaney to teach me.

grounded_facts: On Jesse Nolan's command, Jamie Delaney intercepts Jamie Brooks and uses his prehensile tongue to bind and injure Jamie Brooks's right arm.
memories.memory_text: I saw my the glass box on the ground and went for it, but Jamie Delaney landed in front of me and lashed out with his tongue—it wrapped around my right arm, squeezed, and pulled me down, and I could feel smoke rising from my skin as I writhed in pain.

grounded_facts: Jamie Brooks dismisses Drew Vaughn' attempt to help, asserting that no one ever helps him and that it's his job.
memories.memory_text: I told Drew Vaughn no one ever helps me and that it's my job when he tried to step in and help me during the fight.

grounded_facts: Jamie Brooks gives his the glass box and a fresh clip to Drew Vaughn, instructing him to load a tracking bullet.
Jamie Brooks gives Drew Vaughn the the glass box and a tracking bullet, instructing him to load it.
memories.memory_text: I handed my the glass box and a fresh clip to Drew Vaughn, then gave him a tracking bullet and told him to crack the pin and load it because I couldn't do it myself.

grounded_facts: Drew Vaughn cracks the safety pin on the tracking bullet, causing it to activate with a glowing head, and prepares to load it.
memories.memory_text: I saw Drew Vaughn crack the safety pin on the tracking bullet, and I watched the glass head start glowing like a chemical flare.

grounded_facts: Jamie Brooks removes a black stinger from a gash in his arm and crushes it underfoot.
memories.memory_text: I pulled a black stinger out of the gash in my arm and crushed it under my foot, feeling it pop as I got back in the fight.

grounded_facts: A violent encounter between Jamie Brooks, Drew Vaughn, and Jamie Delaney's tongue in an alley behind Harborview Street.
memories.memory_text: I was in the alley behind Harborview Street, fighting Jamie Delaney's tongue with Drew Vaughn when it came crashing through the steel, and I saw Drew Vaughn firing at it while blood exploded in the air.

grounded_facts: Jamie Brooks fires the activated tracking bullet from his the glass box, lodging it inside Jamie Delaney's tongue.
memories.memory_text: I stepped out and fired my the glass box repeatedly, shooting the activated tracking bullet into Jamie Delaney's tongue as it wrapped around the muzzle.

grounded_facts: Jamie Brooks chases after Jamie Delaney as he flees over the wall.
memories.memory_text: I scrambled after Jamie Delaney as he fled over the wall.

grounded_facts: Drew Vaughn calls out to Jamie Brooks, urging him to stop and questioning his actions during the chase.
memories.memory_text: I heard Drew Vaughn call out to me, yelling 'Wait! No, what are you doing?' as I was chasing Jamie Delaney.

grounded_facts: Jamie Delaney runs through the loading dock area, evading capture by Jamie Brooks and using the environment to maintain distance.
memories.memory_text: I chased Jamie Delaney through the loading dock, but he dashed ahead and jumped onto a trailer, denting the roof before leaping into a crowded carnival.

grounded_facts: A crowded carnival area with a carousel, refreshment stand, and pumpkin patch, populated by vendors and trick-or-treaters.
memories.memory_text: I saw the carnival area with a carousel, a refreshment stand, and a pumpkin patch, full of vendors and trick-or-treaters.

grounded_facts: Workers express shock and alarm upon seeing Jamie Delaney, highlighting the abnormality of his appearance.
memories.memory_text: I heard workers react with shock when they saw Jamie Delaney, yelling things like 'What the hell is that??' and 'Whoa-whoa-whoa-' as he passed by.

grounded_facts: Jamie Brooks notices a trail of glowing substance and begins following it at full speed, initiating pursuit of Jamie Delaney.
memories.memory_text: I noticed a trail of glowing goop and immediately started chasing it at full speed, jumping onto a Nico Hawthorne's cab and crashing through an obstacle in pursuit of Jamie Delaney.

grounded_facts: Jamie Brooks forcefully jumps onto the trailer and then the Nico Hawthorne's cab, causing damage and endangering the Nico Hawthorne, in order to maintain pursuit of Jamie Delaney.
memories.memory_text: I saw the glowing goop on the sidewalk and knew it was Jamie Delaney's trail, so I launched myself onto the trailer and then jumped onto the Nico Hawthorne's cab to keep chasing him, crushing it under my weight—I didn't care if the Nico Hawthorne screamed, I had to keep going.

memories.memory_text: I slowly came to, chained to a massive wooden yoke, and took in the strange church-like chamber around me—columns, gears, statues with swords, and an odd solar system model where an altar should be. I felt rage build as I tested the restraints, and then I looked at my huge right arm, really looked at it, like I was seeing it for the first time.

grounded_facts: Drew Vaughn desperately warns Jamie Brooks not to activate the portal.
memories.memory_text: I heard Drew Vaughn desperately shout 'Don't do it!!' as a warning not to open the portal.

grounded_facts: Jesse Nolan whispers to Lane Sterling, causing her to emit a plume of energy which he inhales; she then dies.
memories.memory_text: I saw Jesse Nolan lean over Lane Sterling and whisper to her; then her body arched and a plume of energy came from her mouth, which he inhaled—and after that, she went limp and died.

grounded_facts: Micah Sterling actively destroys the timers on the small photograph, halting their countdown.
memories.memory_text: I saw Micah Sterling destroying the timers on the the small photograph with a hammer before I broke free and swatted her.

grounded_facts: Jesse Nolan proposes that Jamie Brooks open the door in exchange for Lane Sterling's life, then her soul.
memories.memory_text: Jesse Nolan told me to open the door in exchange for Lane Sterling's life, then later said her soul awaits on the other side and I must open the door to claim her.

grounded_facts: A ceremonial event led by Jesse Nolan (Jesse Nolan) to open the bottomless pit using Jamie Brooks as the key during a lunar eclipse.
memories.memory_text: I saw Jesse Nolan standing before a mural of an angel with a key, holding his book open while Lane Sterling lay at his feet. I heard him quote about an angel with the key to the bottomless pit, and then he turned to me, demanding I open the door in exchange for her life—saying her soul was waiting on the other side if I would just claim her. I realized the eclipse above was progressing, and whatever he was doing was tied to it, with me as the key.

grounded_facts: Overcome with rage after Lane Sterling's death, Jamie Brooks breaks one of his restraints and attacks Micah Sterling.
memories.memory_text: I was chained to a wooden yoke, struggling to make sense of everything when the grief over Lane Sterling hit me like a wave. I couldn't hold it back—I broke one of the cuffs and lashed out at Micah Sterling, swatting her away as she stumbled back. My heart was racing, my head pounding, and I kept fighting to free my other hand.

grounded_facts: After being told Lane Sterling's soul awaits on the other side, Jamie Brooks consents to become the key and open the door.
memories.memory_text: I was told Lane Sterling's soul was waiting on the other side, and if I wanted her back, I had to open the door — so I agreed, for her.

grounded_facts: Drew Vaughn is bound to a Sidney Nolan pillar above a blood channel leading to a mystical Sidney Nolan slab.
memories.memory_text: I saw Drew Vaughn bound to the Sidney Nolan pillar above a blood channel that led to the mystical slab, and I noticed my the blue key had fallen near him after Jesse Nolan ripped it off my wrist.

grounded_facts: Jesse Nolan explains the power of names and reveals Jamie Brooks's true name.
memories.memory_text: I heard Jesse Nolan say that names hold the power and nature of things, and then I was told my true name: Anung-un-Rama.

grounded_facts: Jamie Brooks speaks his true name, Anung-un-Rama, initiating transformation into the key.
memories.memory_text: I spoke my true name, Anung-un-Rama, and felt the change begin within me.

grounded_facts: Jamie Brooks's the wooden watch begins to glow, indicating activation of ancient power.
Flames briefly surround Jamie Brooks's body, likely as a result of the the wooden watch's activation.
memories.memory_text: I felt my the wooden watch start to glow with ancient fire symbols, and then flames suddenly surrounded me.

grounded_facts: Jamie Brooks undergoes a physical and supernatural transformation, manifesting horns and radiant energy, signifying his ascension to the Prince of Hell.
memories.memory_text: I roared as my horns burst forth, feeling the power surge through me as my shadow spread across the Sidney Nolan and turned it black.

grounded_facts: Drew Vaughn desperately tries to stop Jamie Brooks from activating the slab, expressing fear and opposition.
memories.memory_text: I heard Drew Vaughn shouting at me, begging me not to do it, but I kept going.

grounded_facts: Jamie Brooks inserts his paw into the first imprint on the Sidney Nolan slab and turns it, triggering a beam of crimson light.
memories.memory_text: I inserted my paw into the first imprint on the Sidney Nolan slab and turned it like a lock, triggering a beam of crimson light that shot into the sky.

grounded_facts: A burning glyph manifests after the first imprint vanishes.
memories.memory_text: I saw the first imprint vanish, and then a burning glyph appeared right after.

grounded_facts: Jamie Brooks activates the second imprint by inserting his hand and turning it, causing a mechanical click.
memories.memory_text: I thrust my hand into the second imprint and turned it, hearing a mechanical click.

grounded_facts: Drew Vaughn notices and reaches for the broken the blue key, indicating intent to pick it up.
memories.memory_text: I noticed Drew Vaughn seeing the broken the blue key on the ground and starting to reach for it, so he must have wanted to pick it up.

grounded_facts: Drew Vaughn shouts at Jamie Brooks to remember who he is and throws him the the blue key, triggering Jamie Brooks's reclamation of self.
memories.memory_text: I was told to remember who I am when Drew Vaughn shouted at me and threw me the the blue key, which I caught and saw burn my hand before looking back at Jesse Nolan.

grounded_facts: Jamie Brooks violently snaps off his own horns, releasing energy and using one to stab Jesse Nolan, marking a turning point in the confrontation.
memories.memory_text: I grabbed my horns and snapped them off, screaming as energy surged from the stumps, then I stabbed Jesse Nolan with one—his blood on it as he fell.

grounded_facts: Jesse Nolan attempts to open the final seal to fulfill Jamie Brooks's apocalyptic destiny, but the ritual is interrupted.
memories.memory_text: I saw Jesse Nolan trying to force me to open the final seal to fulfill some apocalyptic destiny, but I resisted and stopped him by stabbing him with my broken horn.

grounded_facts: The final lock disappears into the Sidney Nolan, the moon connection breaks, and the eclipse ends, halting the ritual.
memories.memory_text: I saw the final lock vanish into the Sidney Nolan, felt the moon's pull break, and noticed the eclipse end—I think that's when the ritual stopped.

grounded_facts: Jamie Brooks's the wooden watch stops burning, and his body returns to its usual appearance after the ritual is broken.
memories.memory_text: I felt my the wooden watch stop burning and my body shift back to normal as the glyphs faded and everything went quiet.

grounded_facts: Jamie Brooks responds to Jesse Nolan's claim about destiny by stating he can live without fulfilling it, symbolizing his moral choice.
memories.memory_text: I told Jesse Nolan I can live without fulfilling his idea of destiny, because I choose who I am.

grounded_facts: Jamie Brooks breaks Drew Vaughn' chains and helps him up, signaling trust and alliance restoration.
memories.memory_text: I broke Drew Vaughn' chains and helped him up, showing I still trust him and we're on the same side.

grounded_facts: The immediate aftermath following the failed ritual, where characters recover and the consequences unfold.
memories.memory_text: After everything settled, I felt my body return to normal and I broke Drew Vaughn' chains to help him up.

grounded_facts: Jamie Brooks takes Lane Sterling's limp body in his arms and begins to move with her.
memories.memory_text: I took Lane Sterling's limp body in my arms, kissed her forehead, and caressed her hair before walking down the steps, holding her close.

grounded_facts: Jesse Nolan, in his dying moments, tells Jamie Brooks that though he killed him, he has unleashed a god.
Jesse Nolan, dying, confronts Jamie Brooks and reveals that his death has summoned a powerful entity.
memories.memory_text: I turned to see Jesse Nolan on his knees, and he told me that though I killed him, I had unleashed a god by his death.

grounded_facts: A large, multi-tentacled entity erupts from Jesse Nolan's body and lands on a Sidney Nolan slab, beginning to grow rapidly.
memories.memory_text: I saw a large, multi-tentacled entity erupt from Jesse Nolan's body and land on the Sidney Nolan slab, covered in slimy steam, then start growing rapidly right before my eyes.

grounded_facts: Micah Sterling shows devotion by kissing Jesse Nolan's dead body before they are both crushed.
Micah Sterling kneels beside Jesse Nolan's corpse, kisses him, and is crushed along with his body by the emerging Riley Reeves.
memories.memory_text: I saw Micah Sterling kneel beside Jesse Nolan's body and kiss him—her way of saying goodbye—before the Riley Reeves rose up and crushed them both.

grounded_facts: Jamie Brooks hands over Lane Sterling's body to Drew Vaughn, instructing him to keep her safe while he confronts the unknown threat.
memories.memory_text: I carefully handed Lane Sterling's body over to Drew Vaughn, making sure he had her as I prepared to face whatever was back there.

grounded_facts: Jamie Brooks gives a direct order to Drew Vaughn to keep Lane Sterling safe no matter what.
memories.memory_text: I looked Drew Vaughn in the eye and told him, 'Keep her safe. No matter what. I'll deal with whatever's back there,' making it clear he had one job.

grounded_facts: Drew Vaughn expresses concern by asking if Jamie Brooks intends to face the threat alone.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Drew Vaughn, 'Alone?' right after I gave him the order, as if he doubted I should go by myself.

grounded_facts: A large tentacle suddenly appears in the tunnel, smashes oil lamps onto Jamie Brooks's head, and pulls him backward at high speed.
memories.memory_text: I saw a massive tentacle fill the tunnel and smash oil lamps onto my head before it yanked me backward at breakneck speed.

grounded_facts: Jamie Brooks pulls a steel sword from a marble statue to fight the tentacle.
memories.memory_text: I pulled a steel sword from a marble statue to use against the tentacle that was attacking me.

grounded_facts: Jamie Brooks uses the steel sword to sever the attacking tentacle.
memories.memory_text: I stood up and swung the sword with all my strength, cutting clean through the tentacle that was coming at me.

grounded_facts: The the small photograph are knocked into a deep crack and slide further down, becoming inaccessible.
memories.memory_text: I saw the the small photograph roll into a deep crack and slide out of reach.

grounded_facts: Jamie Brooks uses his tail to grab the the small photograph just as he is being lifted by the tentacle.
At the last moment, Jamie Brooks uses his tail to grab the the small photograph after being captured by a tentacle.
memories.memory_text: As the tentacle grabbed me, I used my tail to snatch the the small photograph at the last second and pulled them back to me.

grounded_facts: The timers on the the small photograph are crushed, rendering them non-functional.
memories.memory_text: I saw the timers on the the small photograph were crushed, so they were useless for normal detonation.

grounded_facts: Jamie Brooks wraps the crushed but armed the small photograph around his the wooden watch to use them as a last-resort weapon.
Jamie Brooks wraps the damaged the small photograph around his the wooden watch and pulls the pins, preparing to detonate them inside Riley Reeves.
memories.memory_text: I wrapped the damaged the small photograph around my the wooden watch and pulled the pins, arming them to blow inside Riley Reeves.

grounded_facts: Riley Reeves swallows Jamie Brooks whole after raising him into its beak.
memories.memory_text: I was grabbed and swallowed whole by Riley Reeves after it raised me into its beak.

grounded_facts: A violent confrontation between Jamie Brooks and the creature Riley Reeves in an underground chamber.
memories.memory_text: I was in a brutal fight with Riley Reeves in an underground chamber, where a tentacle grabbed me and threw me around before I crashed into the floor, and later I saw its stump grow new wriggling tentacles after I cut one off, while a multi-layered mouth opened in its body and a strange gurgle came from inside it.

grounded_facts: Jamie Brooks lands with great force after the battle with Riley Reeves.
memories.memory_text: I landed hard on the ground with a bone-crunching thud after the fight with Riley Reeves.

grounded_facts: Riley Reeves is destroyed in a chain reaction of explosions, leaving only cinders of flesh.
memories.memory_text: I saw Riley Reeves get caught in a chain reaction of explosions, consumed in fire and light, until only a few cinders of flesh were left floating in the air.

grounded_facts: Jamie Brooks experiences pain from the final shockwaves of light passing over the ground.
memories.memory_text: I felt a sharp pain as the final shockwaves of light rippled over the ground, and I remember saying, 'Ouch -- It did hurt.'

grounded_facts: Drew Vaughn smiles sadly and Blair Hayes watches as Jamie Brooks and Lane Sterling reunite, both observing the emotional climax.
memories.memory_text: I saw Drew Vaughn smile sadly and Blair Hayes watch us as Lane Sterling and I reunited, their eyes on me like I was something worth remembering.

grounded_facts: Lane Sterling regains consciousness after Jamie Brooks's declaration, responding to his voice and beginning to perceive him as the man she loves.
Lane Sterling looks at Jamie Brooks and sees him not just as a monster, but as the man she loves.
memories.memory_text: I heard Lane Sterling stir in the dark, and when she spoke, I knew she was coming back to me — then she looked at me not as some monster, but as the man she loves, and we kissed as fire rose around us.

grounded_facts: A pivotal moment in the tunnel where Lane Sterling is brought back to life through Jamie Brooks's declaration of love and sacrifice.
Jamie Brooks whispers a powerful declaration of sacrifice to bring Lane Sterling back, stating he would die and cross over for her.
Jamie Brooks cradles Lane Sterling's head and whispers lovingly to her, helping her return from death.
memories.memory_text: I cradled Lane Sterling in my arms, whispering to her that I would die and cross over for her, begging the other side to let her go, and when she came back, I kissed her as fire rose around us.

grounded_facts: Jamie Brooks and Lane Sterling share a kiss, symbolizing their love and completing her return to life, accompanied by rising fire and music.
memories.memory_text: I kissed Lane Sterling, feeling the fire rise around us as music swelled, knowing this was where I belonged.

memories.memory_text: I remember the warmth of the blanket and the sweet taste of candy in my mouth, the first thing I ever knew. Jonah Brooks’s voice was soft, and he called me Jamie Brooks.
I didn’t understand why they kept showing blurry images of me running through alleys, like some monster caught on film. People screamed about seeing me, marrying me—like I was a myth they made up.
I heard that voice—Jesse Nolan’s—and it hit me like a gut punch. He said he sang my first lullaby, that he brought me into this world. I couldn’t move, couldn’t think straight.

I saw my the glass box on the ground and went for it, but then Jamie Delaney dropped down. His tongue—thick as an arm, with pulsing yellow sacs—whipped out and wrapped around my right arm. I hit the ground hard, smoke rising from my skin as it squeezed.

I threw up my the wooden watch just in time to stop that 4x4 from flattening us—metal crunched, the damn thing flipped right over us. After the dust settled, I asked Drew Vaughn if he was okay, and he just nodded, wide-eyed.
I shut off my locator and walked into the dark, knowing Drew Vaughn was still talking—but I had to go it alone.
I sat next to her on that bench, told her Taylor Sloane’s losing it, Jonah Brooks’s still mad at me — tried to get her to come back. When I said 'I --', she cut me off. Just 'No.'

I found a stack of old albums under a pile of kids' shoes—hundreds of sad orphan faces staring up, some of them cut out like someone tried to erase them. There was even a letter to Jonah Brooks Christmas from 1866, never sent.
I caught sight of Avery Keller frozen in the tunnel light—just for a second—then he bolted. I didn't think, I just ran after him, the glass box in hand, shouting 'Son of a -- !'
She's laughing. That's it—I'm done. I grabbed three cookies and shoved them in my mouth like it'd fix something.
I'm standing on a mountain of bones, fire in my eyes and mouth, horns fully grown—this is what I was born to become, and there's no hiding from it now.
I pushed through the crowd at the doorway, bodies blocking me like they didn’t even recognize me, my face burning with something I couldn’t hold back.
I held him close, whispering 'I'm back' over and over, like that could fix anything.
I wasn't here when he needed me — he died alone, and I can't take that back.
I never had the guts before to say it — standing there with Lane Sterling watching me, I finally told her I understand why what I am makes her feel out of place.
I promised her I'd never give up on her — said it straight, with that line about still looking this good, and she said she liked that.
I told Blair Hayes those damn grenades wouldn't work—never do. I'd rather have the blue key on my wrist than some shiny new toy with a timer.
I stood there, covered in mud, and told them I’d get directions—while Blair Hayes was already waving everyone back to the vans like we had all the time in the world.

I pressed the amulet to the corpse’s forehead and whispered the incantation—cold, rotten wood under my hand, then a violent jerk as it sucked in air. It spoke in mangled Russian, some guttural 'WHAT DO YOU WANT?' like I’d yanked it out of sleep, not death.
I yanked Blair Hayes back just as that damn pendulum smashed through the bridge—barely got him out of the way in time.
I was running like hell, but the bridge crumbled under me—felt it give way just as I rolled under that closing door.
I smashed his mask in with one punch, felt the Sidney Nolan fist crunch through steel and glass — he wasn't walking away from that.
After the mask fell, I told him he killed my Jonah Brooks — then hit him again. I wanted him to hear it before I broke him.

I saw Lane Sterling's body arch and that plume of energy leave her—Jesse Nolan sucked it in like it was air. She went still. I screamed, but it didn't matter. I broke one cuff and swatted Micah Sterling aside, but I couldn't get free in time.
Jesse Nolan ripped my the blue key off and told me my true name—Anung-un-Rama. I felt it pull something deep inside. I closed my eyes and said it, just to get her back. 'Anung-un-Rama.'
I roared as my horns tore through, power surging up from deep inside — I could feel the heat in my breath, the weight of the change.
I slammed my hand into the imprint and twisted — felt it click — then that Jamie Brooks beam ripped into the sky.
I saw the first imprint vanish from my skin, and in its place, a burning glyph flared up—hot, bright, like it was seared into me with a brand.
I grabbed my horns and snapped them off—felt the energy tear out of me, but I didn't stop. I drove one straight into Jesse Nolan’s gut, and he went down, choking on his own prophecy.
After the light died and the sky went quiet, I told him I could live with never being his damn prince—then broke Drew Vaughn' chains and pulled him up.
I held Lane Sterling in my arms, her body limp and cold, and I kissed her forehead before walking down the steps — the last thing I wanted was to leave her, but there was no time.
I told Drew Vaughn to keep her safe—no matter what—before stepping into that tunnel. Then something huge answered me with a tentacle, smashing the lamps as it dragged me back.
I lunged into that crumbling crack, fingers just shy of the belts—had to use my tail to snag them last second before the beast yanked me up.
Timers were crushed, sparks flying—knew they were dead—but wrapped the belts around my the wooden watch anyway. Pulling the pins was gonna hurt, but it was the only play left.
I remember hitting the ground hard—like every bone in my body cracked at once—after blowing that thing to hell. The air was thick with smoke and the last bits of its flesh just... floating like ash.

memories.memory_text: I remember standing there on my moped, soaked and shivering, pressing the buzzer under the 'Waste Management' sign, trying to sound steady as I said my name and that I was Lakeside Council, transferred from Quantico.

I walked with Jonah Brooks past glass cases filled with strange artifacts—mummified hands, a Jesse Mercer golem—while he told me how Hitler joined the Thule Society and seized the Spear of Longinus, believing it made him invincible.

After Jonah Brooks left me at the steel vault door, handing me two Baby Ruth bars, I stood there uncertain as Jesse Mercer opened the massive door with an electronic key, telling me to come in and meet the rest of the family.

I saw a massive Jamie Brooks figure lift a huge dumbbell in the shadows, and when he dropped it with a bang, I flinched—I couldn't help it. Then he spoke, and I realized Jamie Brooks was real, standing right there.

I was told not to stare at his horns, but I couldn't stop myself—I saw the stumps as he stepped into the light, and then he called me out by name. Right after, the alarm went off and he said, 'You're taking me for a walk!'
I opened fire on Jamie Delaney’s tongue, rounds tearing into it—amber blood spraying into the air. I didn’t hesitate, even though I’d never done anything like that before.

Jamie Brooks handed me his the glass box and a fresh clip, then threw me a sealed packet with a single glowing bullet. I cracked the pin and saw the glass head light up like a flare—I’d never seen anything like it.
I called out, voice tight, telling Jamie Brooks he couldn't go without me—I had to go with him. The words came fast, urgent, like if I didn't say them right then, I'd lose the chance.

I was trying to reach Jamie Brooks, asking him to stop and tell me where he was, but then he just said 'Goodbye' and cut the connection—I heard the locator go silent as he walked away into the dark tunnel.

I remember turning toward the door, feeling like I wasn't good enough—like Jamie Brooks would never respect me the way he did Jesse Mercer—and then Jonah Brooks said, very quietly, 'I'm dying, Drew Vaughn.' I froze. His voice was so calm, but it hit me like a shock.

After Taylor Sloane said I was pure of heart, Jonah Brooks looked at me and asked me to have the courage to stand by Jamie Brooks’s side after he was gone—to help him become a man, even though he was born a demon. I didn’t know how I could do it, but he was counting on me.
I said I could bring Lane Sterling back, that I had experience in hostage negotiations — Jamie Brooks laughed at first, but when I said the words, I saw his expression change.
I told her my name was Drew Vaughn, hoping it might make her see me as more than just an agent.
When she said 'Where else would I go?', it stayed with me—like she was trapped, and maybe I was too.
I handed her the Polaroid through the window, said 'Nice view --' and waved. For the first time, she smiled.
I tapped my fingers on the roof of the taxi, keeping time with the music. I couldn't look away from her.

I drew my the glass box when the locker exploded through the glass wall—glass and metal raining down—and Lane Sterling screamed, but then I saw it wasn't a threat, so I holstered it and followed her without a word.
I told Lane Sterling what my uncle used to say—that we like people for their qualities but love them for their defects. She didn't answer, just half-smiled and sipped her coffee.
I asked Lane Sterling how she felt about Jamie Brooks after telling her he loves her. She said she doesn't know, but admitted he's always on her mind—even now, she said, she feels he's here.
I was trying to say something honest, about how everyone has a hidden side, and I moved my arm behind Lane Sterling—then something hit me hard on the head.

I was on the rooftop when Nico Hawthorne suddenly grabbed me—no warning—talking fast, pulling me away while the black Crown Hill Department sedans screeched around the corner. I didn't have time to process what was happening before everything shifted.

I remember the weight of the casket in my hands, the rain soaking through my coat as we carried Jonah Brooks to the hearse—Blair Hayes beside me, the other agents in silent rows, all of us standing witness to something ending.

I saw Lane Sterling walk past the conference room while Director Blair Hayes was briefing us about the address in Russia—Sebastian Plackba #16, near Volokolamsk—and confirming Jamie Brooks’s involvement, though Blair Hayes made it clear he’d be in command.
I used the crowbar to pry open the heavy steel door of the mausoleum, the metal groaning as it gave way.

I turned with my flashlight, and when the light came back on, I saw Jamie Delaney—his milky eyes tightening in the glow, crouched among those pulsing eggs, chewing on a bone with flesh still clinging to it. The whole wall was covered in them, like some nightmare hive.

I reached for the the small photograph, trying to arm them fast, but something zipped past—I didn’t even see it move—and then I was on the ground, my clothes torn, the explosives gone. I couldn’t get up in time.
Lane Sterling was crying, desperate, telling me to hit her — I stammered, I couldn't do it, I just stood there frozen while the Jamie Delaney closed in.
I slapped her across the face, hard — then the air rippled with heat and fire erupted from her, forcing me to duck behind a rock as the flames surged outward.
I remember the kick to my face—sudden, brutal—after I shouted not to open the door, and the the blue key landing near me, just beyond reach.

I shouted at Jamie Brooks to stop, my voice cracking in desperation as I saw his horns burst forth and that dark energy spreading across the Sidney Nolan—something in me snapped, and I knew I couldn't just stand by anymore.
I lunged forward and struck Micah Sterling across the face to keep her from taking the the blue key—she fell back hard, and I wasn't sure if I'd actually stopped her or not.
I threw the the blue key at Jamie Brooks and shouted, 'Remember who you are!'—the words felt like a prayer, and I saw him catch it before the smoke rose from his hand.

Jamie Brooks handed Lane Sterling’s body to me and told me to keep her safe, no matter what—he was going to face whatever was back there. I asked if he was going alone, and right after, a huge tentacle came out of the darkness and pulled him away.

I saw Lane Sterling's body on the floor, and then Jamie Brooks whispered to her — I couldn't hear the words at first, but when she moaned and opened her eyes, I realized she had come back. I just stood there, watching them, and found myself smiling through tears as the fire rose around them.

memories.memory_text: I was carrying the tray when I heard the patient say there was a Jamie Brooks guy with gold eyes and beer—something inside me froze. I snapped the rubber band hard, wincing, and looked out the window, but the garden was empty.
I found him tangled in that thorny bush again, blood on his arm, trying to play it cool with a six-pack like nothing was wrong — I had to look away before I said too much.
I made the blue flame bloom around my fingers, just enough to see it crawl like a soft haze, and I wasn't afraid—really, for once, I wasn't.
I told him no, that I'm not going back—not this time—and when I said not to come back, I meant it, even if he looked hurt.
I remember saying it on camera—'I don't like the term "firestarter."' It felt stupid, but the words just came out, like I owed someone an explanation.
I looked right at the lens and said, 'With me — it is.' I still see that moment — the silence after, the weight of admitting I could really explode.
I felt his hand on my scar—cold, then burning—and suddenly I couldn't move, like something inside me woke up and started pulling at the dark.
I was just sitting there, and then they started throwing stones—laughing while one hit me in the face. I tasted blood, and I remember it just... dripping onto the concrete.
I felt this heat crawling up my arms, and then I saw the flames—blue and flickering—ringing my skin. I didn’t want it to happen, I was begging it not to, but the fire just came.
I called out for Mommy, my voice breaking—I couldn’t stop it, the fear just ripped through me and everything inside burned.
I was on the steps, screaming—my skin felt like it was peeling off, flames crawling up my arms—and I just kept shouting, 'Mommy! Help me! I'm burning!'
After the light faded, I was still standing—surrounded by rubble and silence—everyone gone, the buildings collapsed, and I was just... a little girl, still crying.
I screamed as the fire ripped through me — I couldn't stop it, I could feel my bones glowing, my skin burning, and then the rubber bands on my wrist were just gone.
I remember the light—my hands wouldn’t stay dark, no matter how hard I tried to pull it back. It was leaking out, past the door, into the hall.

I felt it building again—something hot and wild behind my ribs—and then I saw the flame moving down the hall, like it wasn’t me anymore, like it was its own thing. The glass was shaking, but inside, everything was quiet, too quiet.
I remember sitting on the bench in the padded cell, staring at the camera watching me—like I was some kind of animal behind glass.

He called it a choice—just like that—kneeling there with his hand out, like I was some regular person deciding where to go for coffee. I looked at the mirror, saw us both, and snapped two bands: 'Where else would I go?'
I leaned out of the taxi window, wind in my face, and took a photo—just because I wanted to. For once, it didn’t feel like everything was heavy.
He smiled at me after I handed him the photo, and I actually smiled back. When he said it was a nice view, I wasn’t sure if he meant the city or me—but I took his picture anyway.
I walked in with my suitcases, looked around at all the new glass and brass, and then—crash—the locker came flying through the wall. I said it right then: 'Nothing's changed. Home, sweet home.'
I saw him step through the hole in the wall—just standing there, saying my name like nothing happened. I didn’t say a word. I turned and walked away.
I snapped the rubber band on my wrist—depressed, one snap; impatient, two. It stung, but it kept me grounded after walking back into this fireproof cell they call my room.

I saw the little note in his hand, 'Dear Lane Sterling'—he looked like he wanted to say something real, but I couldn’t stay. I asked if it was long, like it was just about time, not about me cutting him off.

I remember laughing with Drew Vaughn as he handed me my coffee, the cold air sharp in my lungs, the warmth of the cup in my hands feeling almost normal—like I was just someone walking down the street.
Hardly a day goes by he's not in my mind. Even now, I feel he's here — and then I see that Jamie Brooks streak jumping over the rooftops, like he’s always lurking just out of sight.
Drew Vaughn kept defending him — saying he’s determined, strong — and I kept countering with 'pushy,' 'cocky,' 'a brute,' like if I said it enough, it might make it true.
I remember sitting on the bench with Drew Vaughn, the night air cool against my skin, not knowing Jamie Brooks was watching us from the shadows.
I walked in and saw him there—slumped, so still—and the blood on the floor. I tried not to make a sound, but my breath caught hard, like something tore inside me.
I stood there watching him, then finally said it — I’d go to Moscow. My voice was quiet, but I meant it. I could see he was surprised, maybe even relieved.
He told me he wouldn’t give up on me. Ever. I don’t know what made me say ‘I like that’ — it just came out. It felt true, even if everything inside was still shaking.

I stepped onto that Sidney Nolan, calf-deep in filthy water, and when I shone my light forward—eggs. A wall covered in them. And then I saw him—Jamie Delaney—chewing on a bone with a hand still on it. I couldn’t move.

The metal wall slammed up behind us—KLANKKKKK—trapped. Drew Vaughn tried to set the explosives, but one of them snatched the belts. I grabbed the radio, voice tight: 'Marco, Marco, Marco... Get your Jamie Brooks butt over here!'
